candidates.explanation: For the LOCAL file driver, the transform that serialises the photo path prepends appConfig().frontendDomain (FRONTEND_DOMAIN) instead of appConfig().backendDomain (BACKEND_DOMAIN). Uploaded local files are served by the backend, so the avatar URL points at the web app host and fails to load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain in the LOCAL driver branch.
